comment: Third-party code shaded or copied into the third-party libraries we ship, which the libraries' own metadata does not list. Each package names the library it is contained in, by a purl with the version it was checked for (externalRef OTHER/contained-in); the build fails when that library ships in another version, and when a library shows signs of shaded code but has no entry here. The evidence for each package is in licenseComments.
